reading.rtitle: Ten Days, Three Cities: Our Top Five
paras: Ten days, three cities: Stockholm, Copenhagen and Oslo. Tonight is our last night, so here is our top five.
The best meal: the fish on the island in Stockholm. Simple, fresh and perfect. The worst meal? A cold sandwich at the airport, for twenty dollars!
The most beautiful view: Oslo, from the top of an old tower. There were three hundred stairs. Leão climbed them fast. I was the slowest person on the stairs, but the view was amazing.
The coldest day: Tuesday by the lake in Oslo, minus two degrees. Leão said: “This is the coldest day of my life!” He is from Brazil, of course.
The friendliest people: Ingrid and Mads in Copenhagen. The picnic and the concert were the happiest moments of the trip.
And the biggest surprise? Leão liked the jazz concert more than me!

listenings.text: Welcome to Oslo! My name is Erik, and I drive this bus every day. Oslo is the biggest city in Norway, but it's a small city, really. Only seven hundred thousand people. Is it the most expensive city in Europe? Maybe! A coffee here is eight dollars. The best time to visit is June. The days are the longest of the year, and at eleven at night it is still light. The coldest month is January. Don't come in January! And the best view of the city? Go to the top of the old ski jump. It's the highest place in Oslo, and the view is amazing.

Good morning! Welcome to the oldest fish market in Oslo. Here you can find the freshest fish in the city. It comes from the sea every morning at five. Our most popular dish is the fish soup. It's also the cheapest: only ten dollars a bowl. The best day to come is Saturday, because there is music and the market is the busiest. But for a quiet lunch, come on Tuesday. And please, try our cake. My mother makes it, and I think it's the best cake in Norway!

extra_audio.text: We climbed three hundred stairs to the top of the tower. Claire was the slowest, but the view was the most beautiful of the trip. On Tuesday we walked by the lake. It was the coldest day of my life. Yesterday I had the fish soup at the market. It was the cheapest and the best meal of the trip.
